messages:
Ana (PM): Quick heads up — we need to lock the annual planning offsite dates, agenda, and facilitation owners this week. Options: May 18-19 or May 25-26. Please chime in with constraints.
Karen (People Ops): May 18-19 works for most folks on my side. May 25 has a couple conflicts.
Sam (Design): +1 for May 18-19. Draft agenda idea: 1) company vision + metrics 2) customer insights + deep dives 3) initiative prioritization (value/cost/risk) 4) breakout by themes 5) OKR drafting + alignment.
Li (Eng): Prefer May 18-19 too. Can we set heavy tech deep-dive early morning to accommodate APAC folks?
Omar (Prod Ops): I'll start room requests once dates are confirmed. AV + hybrid kit needed (2 mics, camera for main, Miro license checks).
Ana (PM): Good. Would like facilitators assigned for the prioritization and okr sessions. Volunteers? We should also capture decision owners and success criteria per initiative.
Sam (Design): I can run the breakout design session, and prep a template for the breakouts (problem, metrics, risk, dependencies).
Li (Eng): I can co-facilitate the tech deep dive and own the dependency capture.
Karen (People Ops): I'll handle travel/catering invites. Need headcount + dietary restrictions by Apr 28. I'll send the RSVP form.
planning-bot: Poll created: https://doodle.example/rdw-offsite-2026 (please vote). RSVP form: https://forms.example/rdw-offsite-rsvp
Ana (PM): Prework: each initiative lead should submit a 1-2 page brief + 5-slide deck by Apr 30. Template here: https://drive.example/offsite/templates (feel free to reuse).
Sam (Design): For breakout groups, propose 6 tables: Realtime/Latency, Cost/Optimize, Platform Features, Developer Experience, Security/Compliance, Integrations. Thoughts?
Li (Eng): Makes sense. Suggest moving Developer Experience nearer to Product because it crosses both design and infra.
Omar (Prod Ops): Logistics note: can we stagger start times for remote participants? propose day1 10:00-17:30 PT, day2 09:30-16:00 PT with async recap slots.
Ana (PM): Decision capture — we'll use a single doc per initiative + a decisions log. Facilitators: Ana = prioritization, Sam = breakouts, Li = tech, Karen = logistics/people, Omar = ops/rooms.
Sam (Design): Putting a short facilitation checklist in thread:
```
- Arrive 15m early
- Bring printed templates (or link to Miro)
- Capture decisions + owners in the decision doc
- Timebox: 40m discussion, 20m decision
- If no consensus -> escalate to leadership sync
```
Li (Eng): Who's owner for the final OKR consolidation? Need one person to merge and resolve overlaps.
Ana (PM): I'll own OKR consolidation but need a deputy to surface obvious conflicts before the final edit. @Sam can you be the deputy?
Sam (Design): Yep. I'll do initial pass and flag overlap/conflicts.
Karen (People Ops): Reminder: Accessibility + quiet room for nursing/meditation. Also confirm hotel room block by next Tue.
Omar (Prod Ops): AV vendor recommendation: EchoStream — they support hybrid and live recording. Shall I get quotes?
Ana (PM): Yes please, Omar. Also can someone draft a short landing page for attendees with schedule, Miro links, and travel info? I'll set a placeholder in the drive.
Sam (Design): I can mock a one-pager. Will post wire by Thu.
Li (Eng): A couple asks from Eng: 1) a short list of required infra demos (3 max), 2) a whiteboard session for deployment failure modes.
Ana (PM): Noted. We'll cap demos to keep us on schedule.
Karen (People Ops): RSVP deadline: Fri EOD. I'll compile dietary and travel.
Ana (PM): Thanks all. Action items: Omar -> AV quotes + room booking, Sam -> one-pager + breakout template, Li -> dependency doc stub, Karen -> RSVP form + hotel block, everyone -> initiative briefs by Apr 30. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can meet those.
Sam (Design): :thumbsup:
Li (Eng): :thumbsup:
Omar (Prod Ops): :thumbsup:
Karen (People Ops): :thumbsup:
Ana (PM): Great. If any blockers, ping me directly.
planning-bot: Reminder set for Apr 25 to nudge for prework submissions.
